$schema-note: Song list for the Songs page. Empty on purpose: the corpus annotations are not redistributed in this repository. See the README.

fields.id: song identifier, also used as the .lab filename
fields.title: title
fields.lab: path to the annotation file, relative to data/songs/
fields.videoId: id of the YouTube video used for playback
fields.offset: seconds to add to the annotated timings to line them up with the video
